<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="34" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="22" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">9:41</text>
  <line x1="320" y1="20" x2="320" y2="14" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="325" y1="20" x2="325" y2="11" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="20" x2="330" y2="8" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="335" y1="20" x2="335" y2="5" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="348" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="350" y1="16" x2="354" y2="20" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="363" y="8" width="20" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="365" y="10" width="14" height="8" rx="1" fill="#00C6AE"/>
  <rect x="384" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#18191F"/>

  <!-- title region -->
  <rect x="0" y="34" width="390" height="112" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polyline points="28,91 20,99 28,107" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="21" y1="99" x2="39" y2="99" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="52" y="107" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="27px" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Contact us</text>
  <line x1="358" y1="91" x2="373" y2="106" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="373" y1="91" x2="358" y2="106" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- intro -->
  <rect x="24" y="166" width="342" height="92" rx="16" fill="#E9E7FC" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="202" r="18" fill="#1947E5"/>
  <text x="55" y="208" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="15px" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">C</text>
  <text x="86" y="198" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="17px" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">We’d love to hear from you</text>
  <text x="86" y="222" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="13px" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">Our team usually replies within 1 business day.</text>
  <rect x="86" y="232" width="102" height="18" rx="9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="137" y="245" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#1947E5">Support team</text>

  <!-- form -->
  <text x="32" y="291" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="15px" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Full name</text>
  <rect x="32" y="302" width="326" height="56" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="52" y="337" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="15px" font-weight="500" fill="#969BAB">Alex Morgan</text>

  <text x="32" y="391" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="15px" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Message</text>
  <rect x="32" y="402" width="326" height="146" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="52" y="436" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="15px" font-weight="500" fill="#969BAB">Tell us how we can help...</text>
  <line x1="52" y1="455" x2="338" y2="455" stroke="#EEEFF4" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="52" y="482" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="13px" font-weight="500" fill="#969BAB">I’d like to learn more about getting started</text>
  <text x="52" y="509" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="13px" font-weight="500" fill="#969BAB">with Contra and finding the right opportunities.</text>
  <text x="32" y="570" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">Please don’t include sensitive personal information.</text>

  <!-- send button shadow and button -->
  <rect x="32" y="598" width="326" height="60" rx="16" fill="#18191F"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="32" y="592" width="326" height="60" rx="16" fill="#1947E5" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="629" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="17px" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">Send message</text>
    <line x1="286" y1="622" x2="310" y2="622" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="302,614 310,622 302,630" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- small privacy row -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="692" r="8" fill="#00C6AE"/>
  <polyline points="35,692 38,695 44,688" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="55" y="697" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">Your message is private and secure.</text>
  <text x="55" y="718" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="12px" font-weight="700" fill="#1947E5">Read our privacy policy</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="754" width="390" height="90" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="754" x2="390" y2="754" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="38,783 50,773 62,783 62,797 54,797 54,788 46,788 46,797 38,797" fill="none" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="50" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="12px" font-weight="700" fill="#969BAB">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="128" cy="784" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="135" y1="792" x2="143" y2="800" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="128" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="12px" font-weight="700" fill="#969BAB">Explore</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="785" r="17" fill="#F4F5F7" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="777" x2="195" y2="793" stroke="#1947E5" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="187" y1="785" x2="203" y2="785" stroke="#1947E5" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="12px" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Create</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="264" y="775" width="20" height="17" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="269,792 269,797 275,792" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="280" cy="780" r="2" fill="#F95A2C"/>
    <text x="274" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="12px" font-weight="700" fill="#969BAB">Inbox</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="340" cy="779" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#1947E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="340" cy="795" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#1947E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="340" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="12px" font-weight="800" fill="#1947E5">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
